item.title: Marine heat waves boost coastal CO₂ uptake by 11%, analysis finds
item.description: Marine heat waves are a consequence of climate change and are increasingly altering marine and coastal regions worldwide. An international study led by the Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon now shows that many coastal seas absorb more CO₂ from the atmosphere during these extreme events than under normal conditions. The effect is particularly pronounced in polar and subpolar shelf seas of the Northern Hemisphere, where sea ice is declining as temperatures rise. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Giant new dinosaur discovered beneath construction site in Brazil
item.description: Scientists have identified a giant new dinosaur from Brazil that reached about 20 meters long and lived 120 million years ago. Its surprising evolutionary ties to a Spanish dinosaur suggest its ancestors crossed ancient land connections between Europe, Africa, and South America. Fuente: ScienceDaily.

item.title: In 1980, conservationists began eradicating feral sheep to restore California's Santa Cruz Island
item.description: Conservationists undertook a significant effort to remove feral sheep from Santa Cruz Island, aiming to revive its delicate ecosystem. Over seven years, thousands of these sheep were eliminated, risking the extinction of a unique heritage breed. To counter this, twelve lambs were rescued to spearhead a captive breeding initiative on the mainland, ensuring the preservation of a rare genetic lineage and honoring California's rich agricultural heritage. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: México afronta un nuevo reto en la reducción de la jornada a 40 horas: que los empleados puedan comer
item.description: Falta poco más de un año para que la semana laboral en México empiece a reducirse de las 48 horas actuales a las 40 horas semanales que deben alcanzar en 2030. Es ahora cuando empresas y trabajadores deben afrontar el reto de organizar el trabajo para continuar produciendo lo mismo, pero aprovechando mejor el tiempo de la jornada laboral. Uno de los escollos que están encontrando los empleadores en esa búsqueda choca frontalmente con la normativa aprobada a principios de año por el Senado.
